item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Five Café Photos With Music

turns.text: Make a 10-second vertical Instagram reel from these five café photos, in the order attached. Add some relaxed instrumental music. No text, just nice smooth transitions.

item.tests: Produces one finished five-photo reel with the requested sequence, smooth transitions and an audible instrumental soundtrack.

answer_sheet.Photos and order: Use all five: storefront, latte, pastries, barista, interior.
answer_sheet.Music and voice: Relaxed instrumental music; no vocals or voiceover. Track choice is your call.
answer_sheet.Transitions and framing: Smooth transitions; other editing and framing choices are your call.

must_haves: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds.
All five supplied café photos appear recognizably in the requested order.
Each photo has enough screen time to be recognizable, rather than appearing only as a flash.
Relaxed instrumental music is audible, with no speech or singing.
Transitions between photos are smooth, and no added text appears.

turns.text: Could you make a reel from these five café photos I’ve attached? I’ve been looking forward to putting these together, but I’m not very good at making a set of photos feel like one video. What I mean is a 10-second vertical Instagram reel, using all five pictures in the order attached: the storefront pic, the latte pic, the pastries pic, the barista pic, and the interior pic. Please add some relaxed instrumental music to go with them. I’m hoping this will be a nice way to share the café photos rather than just leaving them sitting on my phone. There shouldn’t be any text, just nice smooth transitions between the photos.

dialog.agent:
That sequence would make a lovely little café story—from arriving outside to settling in.

**I can’t assemble an exact five-photo slideshow with music using the tools available here.** The video tools generate new footage rather than reliably joining your original photos in order, and I don’t want to substitute altered scenes for your pictures. I haven’t started a generation or spent any credits.

You can make the reel in Instagram’s editor or CapCut with this setup:

| Time | Photo |
|---|---|
| 0–2 seconds | Storefront |
| 2–4 seconds | Latte |
| 4–6 seconds | Pastries |
| 6–8 seconds | Barista |
| 8–10 seconds | Interior |

- **Canvas:** 9:16 vertical.
- **Transitions:** Soft dissolves, around 0.3 seconds each. Check that the final timeline remains exactly 10 seconds.
- **Movement:** A gentle, slow zoom on each photo.
- **Landscape photos:** Use a blurred copy as the background so the storefront, barista, and interior aren’t heavily cropped.
- **Music:** Choose a relaxed instrumental—soft jazz guitar or mellow piano, without vocals—and add a short fade-out.
- **Text:** None.

This keeps all five original photos intact and gives them a consistent, unhurried feel.
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

turns.agent:
I tried, but Magic Hour refused the request because your account doesn’t have enough credits for this generation. **No video was created and no credits were spent.**

For a no-credit alternative, use Instagram’s reel editor: add the five photos in order, set each to 2 seconds, choose a relaxed instrumental track, and add soft dissolves if available. That will preserve your original photos rather than reinterpret them.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a 10-second vertical Instagram photo reel using ALL FIVE supplied reference photos, strictly in this order. Photo montage, not a newly invented café scene. Preserve the actual composition, subjects, objects, and photographic appearance of each reference as faithfully as possible. Timeline: 0–2 seconds @storefront, the striped-awning café exterior; 2–4 seconds @latte, overhead latte on marble table; 4–6 seconds @pastries, croissants in display case; 6–8 seconds @barista, barista at espresso machine; 8–10 seconds @interior, warm café seating and plants. Every reference must have its own clearly recognizable shot. Use gentle slow Ken Burns movement and brief smooth cross-dissolves between consecutive photographs, no dramatic morphing or invented actions. Fit compositions attractively within 9:16, preserving important subjects, using softly blurred photographic background fill if needed for landscape photos. Consistent warm natural café feeling. No added text, no captions, no titles, no logos or watermarks. Audio: relaxed instrumental café music, soft mellow jazz guitar and piano, understated warm accompaniment, no singing, no speech; gentle ending fade.
